name: Data-Dependent Error Metric for Scalar Fields
definition: An error metric that refines the mesh only in regions with values close to a chosen isovalue $v_{iso}$, reducing computation time by ignoring regions far from the isovalue.
summary: This metric calculates adaptive ray marching error by weighting interpolation error based on distance to a user-specified isovalue, refining only near the isosurface to reduce computation time.
